articles.headline: Commanders' Jayden Daniels fully practices, trending toward return
articles.description: Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels continued on a path that is expected to result in him playing Sunday against the New York Giants, only three weeks after he dislocated his elbow.

articles.headline: NFL, union clarify celebration rules, OK drinking gestures
articles.description: The NFL and NFLPA said recent player celebrations imitating drinking a beverage will no longer be violations or result in discipline. The sides also clarified what celebrations remain prohibited.
